priorityList: Use Dragonrage on cooldown when enemies will survive at least 15 seconds.
Activate Tip the Scales during Dragonrage, ideally to instantly cast Eternity Surge or Fire Breath.
Cast Fire Breath at Empowerment Level 1 to apply its damage-over-time effect, ensuring it is refreshed if using the Consume Flame talent.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empowerment Level 1 while Dragonrage is active or when Fire Breath is already ticking on targets.
Use Deep Breath if talented into Imminent Destruction, provided Fire Breath is currently on cooldown.
Spend Essence on Disintegrate if Mass Disintegrate is talented to trigger Bombardments on multiple targets.
Spend Essence on Pyre if there are 4 or more enemies, or if you have 12 or more stacks of Charged Blast.
Cast Azure Sweep as your primary filler to generate Essence and maintain combat buffs.
Cast Living Flame when Leaping Flames is active, especially if you have Burnout or Scarlet Adaptation procs.
Use Azure Strike as a low-priority filler or when movement is required and Hover is unavailable.
Activate offensive Trinkets and Potions during Dragonrage, specifically when Rising Fury stacks are high (4+).
Use Verdant Embrace before or during combat if Scarlet Adaptation is talented to convert healing into a damage proc.
Use Hover to maintain casting uptime during movement-heavy phases.
Interrupt enemy casts with Quell whenever available.
